verdict.rationale: Langfuse docs describe cost/usage tracking with dashboards that break down spend 'across models, tags, or users' plus native session and user tracking, and a Metrics API to query aggregate cost/usage/latency by these dimensions. This directly supports attributing cost to users, sessions, and tag-based feature/metadata groupings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of arbitrary custom metadata fields (beyond tags) as a first-class cost-attribution dimension, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific attribution workflow.
